languageModelTools.name: bonsai_generate_context
languageModelTools.userDescription: Generate self-contained Bonsai context files for the current workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Generate or update self-contained Bonsai repository context files in the active VS Code workspace. Use this when bonsai.xml or bonsai.json does not exist, or when the existing context is stale, before answering broad repository questions. Call this tool instead of a VS Code command. If this tool is unavailable because the user has not enabled it, tell the user to open VS Code Agent mode, select Select Tools, and enable Generate Bonsai Context, or explicitly reference #bonsai_generate_context in chat. It scans supported source files, always ignores common dependency and build directories such as node_modules and target, respects .gitignore and .cursorignore, compresses content to the configured token budget, and writes bonsai.xml or bonsai.json plus numbered chunks under 10 MB each. It returns the generated file paths and the first context file contents. Do not use it for narrow questions that do not need broad repository context.

workspacePath.description: Optional absolute path of an open workspace folder. Omit it to use the active workspace.

bonsai.maxTokens.description: Token budget for generated Copilot context.

bonsai.level.description: Compression: 1 full source first, 2 signatures and shapes, 3 names and tree map. Start with 2.

bonsai.outputFile.description: File path where generated context is written.

bonsai.outputFormat.description: Generated context format. The extension supports XML and JSON.

bonsai.include.description: Optional glob patterns to include, such as src/**.

bonsai.exclude.description: Optional glob patterns to exclude, such as **/generated/**.
